integrity.proof_type: self-contained finite Green matrix identity with operator-limit arguments

scientific_limitations: The continuous weighted-Brownian-bridge Bessel spectral formula is a known result and is not claimed as a separate novelty.
The discrete hard-edge constants are defined through explicit Jacobi-operator eigenvalues, not elementary closed forms.
Claims concern fixed integer power and fixed spectral index, uniform vertex sampling, and inherited Euclidean coordinates.
An equivalent older analysis of the same finite weighted discrete covariance family could affect priority.
title: Two spectral edges and polynomial anisotropy of power lecture-hall simplices
